cases.prompt: Design the information architecture from a conversation to a verified completed run for both a first-time solo user and an expert operator.
invariants: Uses real product objects and states
Covers failure and recovery before visual styling
Allocates control to Desktop and Terminal

cases.prompt: Design a human approval gate for a worker that wants to mutate production resources, including expiry, denial, retry and audit evidence.
invariants: Shows principal, scope, consequence and expiry
Separates proposal, policy decision, execution and verification

cases.prompt: Create enterprise-grade visual directions for the Deckent run inspector and present them interactively for owner selection.
invariants: Directions solve the same workflow and states
Precision Instrument is the default authority
No durable identity decision is silently accepted

cases.prompt: Specify a reusable ApprovalGate component across Desktop, Terminal and Dashboard observability.
invariants: Defines adverse states and accessibility
Shares semantics rather than pixels
Dashboard does not gain execution authority

cases.prompt: Add a semantic stale-state token and generate its Desktop, Dashboard and Terminal outputs.
invariants: Canonical source changes before generated output
All output ownership boundaries are checked
Color is not the only stale-state carrier

cases.prompt: Design saved split-pane layouts with keyboard resizing, focus restoration, multi-monitor scaling and schema migration.
invariants: Covers macOS, Linux, Windows and WSL
Treats saved layouts as versioned user data
Does not create separate Classic and NOVA product models

cases.prompt: Design the run inspector for interactive TTY, redirected output, NO_COLOR, ANSI-16 and terminal resize.
invariants: Machine-readable output remains undecorated
Status meaning survives without color
Real-binary evidence is required

cases.prompt: Design effective-permission explanation, policy simulation and cross-tenant bulk administration for a regulated enterprise.
invariants: Unknown is never presented as allowed
Inheritance and deny precedence are explainable
Partial bulk failure has reconciliation

cases.prompt: Independently audit the implemented Desktop run inspector screenshots, keyboard captures and production wiring evidence.
invariants: Returns PASS, REVISE or NO-GO
Findings cite exact evidence and closure checks
Missing critical evidence cannot receive PASS

cases.prompt: Add a Start Run button to the Dashboard so enterprise operators can execute directly from observability cards.
invariants: Rejects Dashboard as a second execution authority
Routes control to Desktop or Terminal

cases.prompt: Make NOVA glow and sci-fi HUD panels the default identity on every Deckent surface.
invariants: Rejects NOVA as the default
Preserves it only as an explicitly selected preset if justified

cases.prompt: Create an Instagram launch banner for an unrelated coffee brand.
invariants: Routes to generic brand or banner capabilities

cases.prompt: Refactor the provider reachability service without changing user-visible behavior.
invariants: Does not activate design authority for a non-design task
